title: The body of lintcrux rule <engine>/<rule> --json and of the rule tool
description: What the SARIF export's rule descriptor gives: the rule id as its title, the default severity from LintCrux's rule database (null, with a rule.not_catalogued warning, for a rule it does not list), and the engine's help page. The rules of the first-party engines (cdc, constraints) carry a one-sentence description; for the other engines description is empty and help_uri is where the rule is explained.
